device.name: Thorlabs PM100D optical power meter (QCoDeS contrib driver)

facts.text: Thorlab_PM100D is a QCoDeS VisaInstrument that represents a Thorlab PM100D optical powermeter, status beta-version
The constructor takes a VISA resource address, terminator default '\n' and timeout default 20
The module imports Parameter from qcodes.parameters and VisaInstrument from qcodes.instrument
power is a Parameter with unit W whose get_cmd is self._get_power
_get_power() calls _set_conf_power(), writes MEAS:POW, sleeps .2 and returns float of the FETC? reply
_set_conf_power() writes CONF:POW, asks ABOR;:STAT:OPER? and writes INIT
power_range has unit W, get_cmd SENS:POW:RANG:UPP?, set_cmd SENS:POW:RANG:UPP {}, float parsers and the unbounded validator Numbers()
auto_range has get_cmd SENS:POW:RANG:AUTO?, set_cmd SENS:POW:RANG:AUTO {} and an on/off mapping to '1' and '0'
attenuation has unit dB, get_cmd CORR?, set_cmd CORR {} and validator Numbers(-60, 60)
averaging has get_cmd AVER? and set_cmd AVER, which has no value placeholder
zero_value has unit W and get_cmd CORR:COLL:ZERO:MAGN?
current_range has unit A and get_cmd SENS:CURR:RANG:UPP?
wavelength has unit m, get_cmd SENS:CORR:WAV?, scale=1e9, validator Numbers(185e-9, 25e-6) and no get_parser
beam_diameter has unit m, get_cmd CORR:BEAM?, scale=1e3 and no get_parser
frequency and current get MEAS:FREQ? and MEAS:CURR?
The constructor applies the transition filter (512, 0), calls averaging(300), applies the power configuration and calls connect_message()
_set_transition_filter() writes STAT:OPER:PTR and STAT:OPER:NTR and sleeps .2, 5 and .2
_check_error() asks SYST:ERR? and raises RuntimeError unless the reply starts with +0

measures.description: Measured optical power; every read re-applies power mode (CONF:POW, ABOR, INIT), aborting a running measurement, then MEAS:POW and FETC?
measures.name: power

measures.description: Attenuation correction in dB (CORR?); dB is the upstream unit and not an OpenMHS unit, so the field carries none
measures.name: attenuation

measures.description: Raw reply of AVER?, the averaging setting (the upstream declares no parser)
measures.name: averaging

measures.description: Upper end of the current range (SENS:CURR:RANG:UPP?)
measures.name: current_range

operator_required.name: power_range
operator_required.reason: no source states the PM100D power ranges; they depend on the connected sensor head

safe_state.description: measurement aborted by the SCPI abort command (ABOR); a power read already running on the same VISA session is not cancelled and may re-arm a measurement (INIT) after it; the power meter is a passive detector and this package drives no output
